name: ⚡ HvH ARENA [1.0] — THE HVH OVERHAUL ⚡
desc:
⚡ HvH ARENA 1.0 HAS ARRIVED ⚡

This is not just another update.
The entire HvH experience has been overhauled.

🎯 ADVANCED RAGEBOT
Experience sharper targeting, improved hitchance logic and an advanced CS:GO-inspired resolver.

🌀 REAL ANTIAIM
Master real desync, fake angles, pitch manipulation and fully configurable AntiAim presets.

🎨 FULLY CUSTOMISABLE VISUALS
Change your colors, lighting, skybox, materials and atmosphere. Build the arena around your style.

🔥 THE 1.0 OVERHAUL
• Smoother and more responsive combat
• Improved movement and weapon timing
• Custom characters and weapons
• Refined UI and controls
• Better progression and match flow
• Major stability and performance improvements

Enter the arena.
Build your configuration.
Outplay everyone.

⚡ UNSEEN TECHNOLOGY.
⚔️ HvH ARENA 1.0.
